名词的构成与类别: The snowman has a red hat.
A police car is in the street.
The zoo keeper feeds the ladybug.
副词的用法: Let us play the game later.
其他介词: I have a bag with two apples.
A bee goes from flower to flower.
方位与方向介词: The fish is in the lake.
The pot is on the stove.
The birds fly over the hill.
特殊疑问句: What do you have in your bag?
Who can help the little dog?
动词短语: Please look at my new book.
We go to the park on Sunday.
Put on your coat, it is cold.
数量表达: I have ten fingers and ten toes.
Some birds are in the tree.
There is a lot of milk in the glass.
否定句: I can not swim in the sea.
He has no hair on his head.
The cats do not make any noise.
直接引语: "I am hungry," said the little bear.
人称代词: She gives me a big red apple.
They carry heavy things on their backs.
We play games with them after school.
指示代词 this / that / these: This is my little red dog.
Is that your ball over there?
一般过去时: My balloon went up in the sky.
Did Buddy wait for his friend?
We were very happy at the party.
too 的用法: My dog can run fast, too!
